purpose: Teach: 磯/黒髪/アジサイ/めがね/山菜/乳製品/谷間/偉人

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族で磯遊びに行ったろ?
lines.en: Riku — did your family go tidepooling last summer or something?
lines.style: Light, probing curiosity. Testing whether he'll engage or deflect. A soft smile underneath. Leans on the question mark.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、髪染めなくても黒髪似合うぞ、桜
lines.en: You don't need to dye your hair, you know. Black really suits you, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet, almost reluctant sincerity. Not quite meeting her eyes while saying it. Quick delivery, like he's rushing past his own words before he loses nerve.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、お庭にアジサイあるんだろ?
lines.en: Hey, Riku — your place has hydrangeas in the garden, right?
lines.style: Gentle prod, genuinely interested in the detail. Slight lift at the end like she's offering him an out — a safe topic. No pressure.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、新しいめがね買ったろ?桜
lines.en: Wait — did you get new glasses? When?
lines.style: Quick, direct attention. Noticing something he probably hoped would go unmentioned. Warm underneath the observation, not teasing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族で山菜採りに行ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, your family went foraging in the mountains this year, didn't they?
lines.style: Softer curiosity now. Drawing him into memory. Pacing steady and patient, like she's giving him space to remember.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、給食の乳製品残すなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't skip the dairy at lunch, okay? You need it.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact care disguised as direction. No room for argument but not unkind. The tone of someone who has been paying attention to what he leaves on his tray.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族で谷間ハイキング行ったろ?
lines.en: So your family did that valley hike — was it the one near the shrine?
lines.style: Conversational, drawing him back in. Warm curiosity. Building on what she already knows, inviting him to expand.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で地域の偉人やったろ?桜
lines.en: Didn't you do a presentation on local historical figures in social studies?
lines.style: Gently checking whether he remembers, or maybe checking if he's willing to talk about it. Close attention, like she's been listening when he talks about school.
